{{Quote|Be on your guard&mdash;native gorgodons have an appetite for carbon based lifeforms!''"<br />"''That's an understatement! Is the Council trying to kill us?|Notes left by Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi in a copy of ''The Jedi Path''|<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>}}
'''Gorgodons''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of large, [[Hair/Legends|furry]], [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptile]] that lived on the [[Water/Legends|snow]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]. They possessed [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]-proof hide, a strong [[Bone/Legends|bone]] structure, and three rows of sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], all of which made them dangerous foes in combat. Gorgodons had excellent senses of smell and hearing, which they relied upon due to poor vision. Despite being able to survive by [[Diet/Legends|eating]] just [[Plant/Legends|plants]], gorgodons spent most of their [[Time/Legends|time]] hunting live prey in groups, preferring to [[Death/Legends|kill]] by suffocation or through crushing it with an embrace. Members of the species lived in camouflaged nests of shelter, which they held together with their saliva.

Gorgodons sometimes encountered [[Jedi/Legends|members]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], who traveled to Ilum to find [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] with which to build their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in the [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Crystal Caves]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], fought a group of gorgodons outside the Crystal [[Cave/Legends|Caves]] when they traveled to the creatures' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]], as did the ex-Jedi [[Ferus Olin]] around the year [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. The gorgodons that fought Olin were later killed by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|Triple rows of teeth, sharp claws. They dispatch their victims by squeezing them to death. The only way to kill them is a blow to the back of the neck.|Obi-Wan Kenobi describes gorgodons to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="JQ:PtT" />}}
Gorgodons were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of hulking [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] predators that were native to the [[Water/Legends|icy]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]. Large in size,<ref name="JQ:PtT" /> their backs and [[Limb/Legends|forearms]] were partially covered in [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]]. The rest of their bodies were covered with gray hide<ref name="UA" /> thick enough to prevent [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] from [[Death/Legends|killing]] them,<ref name="TLotJ:DW" /> except for the head, which was yellow in color. The face of a gorgodon consisted of two<ref name="UA" /> yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] with pupils,<ref name="TLotJ:DW" /> four [[Nose/Legends|nostrils]],<ref name="UA" /> and a [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] filled with three rows of yellow [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. Due to poor eyesight, the predators relied mostly on their hearing and sense of smell to locate prey or other [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]&mdash;which could include [[Plant/Legends|vegetation]] or carrion, as the species was [[Diet/Legends|omnivorous]].<ref name="TLotJ:DW" />

Gorgodons had a bipedal stance, with a tail and four limbs, standing on their hind limbs and using their forelimbs for attack, although they could also walk on all fours. Each limb ended in a paw that could be equal in size to a [[Hoversled/Legends|gravsled]] and included several sharp claws. The creatures had incredibly strong [[Bone/Legends|bone]] structures that were covered by thick layers of muscle and fat, making them fairly resistant to blunt force attack, though they had a soft, vulnerable point on the back of the neck.<ref name="TLotJ:DW" /> Striking this weak point was the only way to kill the beasts, as doing so would sever their spine and paralyze them.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|353|gorgodon}}</ref> Their large size provided them with power when striking against their prey but also made them clumsy and at [[Time/Legends|times]] slow.<ref name="JQ:PtT" /> Members of the species were capable of producing a thick, brown, [[Rubber/Legends|rubber]]y saliva, which they used in the construction of their nests.<ref name="TLotJ:DW" />

==Behavior==
{{Quote|The gorgodons are just hungry! Try giving them your rations next time.|Ahsoka Tano suggests one way Jedi might avoid fighting gorgodons in a note in ''The Jedi Path''|<ref name="TJP" />}}
[[File:Ilum-TOR.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Gorgodons were native to the planet Ilum.]]
Gorgodons were most commonly found on the lowland areas of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Ilum, where they survived on a diet of [[Lichen/Legends|lichen]], scrubs, and carrion, although it was not uncommon for them to venture into the planet's [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] regions.<ref name="JQ:PtT" /> They did, however, most commonly hunt live prey, traveling together in family groups of four to eight<ref name="UA" /> and using their senses of smell and hearing to locate other animals. When they attacked, they snapped their jaws and rolled their eyes, usually killing their prey by crushing or suffocating them in a hugging motion with their huge forelimbs, although they could use their claws, teeth, and tails to injure their opponents as well.<ref name="JQ:PtT" />

When they attacked or were injured, the creatures would roar or howl loudly, and if one of their number was killed, a pack would retreat upon picking up the scent of their fellow's death. Gorgodons could also use their claws for climbing the frosted cliffs and mountains of Ilum, at which they were extremely skilled.<ref name="JQ:PtT" /> Gorgodons constructed nests with shelters inside using boulders, sheets of ice, and snow as well as their saliva, which acted like mortar and held the structures together. The shelters were about fifty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height and were similar in appearance to a hunched gorgodon's back. The nests could be camouflaged to blend into the surrounding environment, mimicking the steep slopes of the mountains on which they were built.<ref name="TLotJ:DW" />

==History==
===Republic Era===
{{Quote|Don't know what the fuss is about&mdash;I easily killed three of them.|A note concerning gorgodons left by Anakin Skywalker in a copy of ''The Jedi Path''|<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Star_Wars_The_Jedi_Path_Vault.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Several Jedi left notes concerning gorgodons in the ''The Jedi Path''.]]
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22,800 BBY]], the planet Ilum was discovered by [[Jedi/Legends|members]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], who found an abundance of [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] in the world's [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Crystal Caves]]. The [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]], as it turned out, could be used to make [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. As such, the Order made journeying to Ilum to find such a crystal part of the [[Jedi training/Legends|ceremony]] that almost all Jedi underwent on their way to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knighthood]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> As natives of Ilum, gorgodons occasionally encountered Jedi who were on such quests, often leading to the beasts attacking the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who was active during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], left a note warning future students of the danger of gorgodons in his copy of the [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''. Jinn later passed down the book to his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who also left a message of his own regarding the gorgodons.<ref name="TJP" />

In the year [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Kenobi traveled with his Padawan, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to Ilum to help him find a crystal for his [[Anakin Skywalker's first lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The pair encountered a group of [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]] gorgodons in front of the entrance to the Crystal [[Cave/Legends|Caves]], and their scent woke the beasts, causing the group to attack the two Jedi. One gorgodon managed to grab Kenobi and attempted to crush him. Skywalker saved his Master by stabbing the predator in the vulnerable point at the back of its neck, killing it and causing the rest of the group to flee by climbing further up the mountain.<ref name="JQ:PtT" /> Skywalker later claimed to have killed three gorgodons on Ilum in a note he left in his copy of ''The Jedi Path'', which Kenobi had given him. When Skywalker's apprentice, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], inherited the book, she added a note claiming that gorgodons were simply hungry and could be avoided if they were given [[Ration pack/Legends|rations]] instead of attacked.<ref name="TJP" />

===Imperial Era===
{{Quote|It'll be better than a nest of gorgodons.|Ferus Olin|<ref name="TLotJ:DW" />}}
[[File:FerusOlin.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Ferus Olin fought a group of gorgodons on Ilum.]]
Later, in about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> after being warned about the gorgodons by Kenobi, the former Jedi [[Ferus Olin]] traveled to Ilum, hoping to craft a lightsaber and find the Jedi Master [[Garen Muln]]. He sought to enter the Crystal Caves through a secret entrance at the back of a gorgodon nest, which he located despite it being camouflaged. After trying and failing to sneak past the sleeping gorgodons in the nest, Olin attempted to flee from them, but one of the group caught him and beat him around. The former Jedi eventually managed to paralyze the gorgodon by driving a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] into its vulnerable spot, which allowed him to escape.<ref name="TLotJ:DW" />

The gorgodons' nest was later [[Fire/Legends|burned]] and destroyed by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], who used [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]] and [[Flechette launcher/Legends|flechette launchers]] to open fire on the nests in an attempt to prevent Olin leaving through the secret entrance. The gorgodons fought back but were quickly defeated and killed.<ref name="TLotJ:DW" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:GorgodonAttack-AnakinApprentice.png|thumb|right|300px|Tommy Lee Edwards' depiction of gorgodons differed from an illustration by Andrew Jones.]]
Gorgodons first appeared in [[2001]] in ''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]'', a novel written by [[Jude Watson]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Jedi Quest|''Jedi Quest'']] series.<ref name="JQ:PtT" /> The creatures were then first pictured in the [[2002]] novel ''[[Anakin: Apprentice]]'' in an illustration drawn by artist [[Tommy Lee Edwards]]. The illustration was highly stylized, but showed the creatures with four eyes, a single row of teeth on each jaw with two prominent canine teeth on the upper jaw, and ribbed brown and gray skin including a gray face.<ref name="Apprentice">''[[Anakin: Apprentice]]''</ref>

The [[2004]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Ultimate Adversaries]]'' then included a clearer illustration of a gorgodon by [[Andrew Jones]] that notably differed<ref name="UA" /> from the first depiction<ref name="Apprentice" /> in several ways, including fur across the creatures' body apart from a yellow face, only two eyes, and three rows of more evenly sized teeth. This article assumes the newer depiction to be accurate as it more closely resembles<ref name="UA" /> the description of gorgodons having three rows of teeth given in ''Jedi Quest: Path to Truth''.<ref name="JQ:PtT" />
